job.title: Junior AI Engineer
job.description:
Edventure is building an AI-powered learning platform used by teachers and students. We are a small team, and every engineer owns real features from idea to production.

The role:
You will build features across the whole product: React UI, Node.js APIs, AI-powered flows, and the small product decisions in between. You won't be handed one narrow type of ticket. You will learn by shipping, with a senior teammate reviewing your work.

What you'll do:
- Build and improve user-facing features in React (teacher and student flows).
- Write and maintain backend endpoints and background jobs in Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- Integrate AI models (LLMs, speech, vision) into real product features.
- Fix bugs, write clean code, and add tests where they matter.
- Talk to users and teachers, understand their problems, and suggest improvements.
- Learn how production systems run: queues, monitoring, deployments.

What we offer:
- Real ownership and fast growth from day one.
- Mentorship from senior engineers.
- A product that has an impact on students and teachers.
- Office in Herzeliya.
job.requirements:
What we're looking for:
- Bachelor or Master's degree in Engineering field.
- 1-3 years of experience with strong projects.
- Solid JavaScript. React and Node.js experience is a plus.
- Comfortable with Git, APIs and SQL basics.
- Curious about AI and eager to use it, including AI coding tools, to move faster.
- You like building things end to end and aren't afraid to touch unfamiliar code.
- Good English, written and spoken. Hebrew is not required.

Nice to have:
- Experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.).
- A project you built and shipped yourself.
- Interest in education.
